target.definition: Number of people (Japanese and foreign residents combined) who moved between municipalities within Japan in August 2026, as first reported in the Statistics Bureau of Japan's monthly Report on Internal Migration in Japan Derived from the Basic Resident Registration.

inputs.name: japan_population
inputs.description: Total population of Japan (Japanese and foreign residents) in 2026.

provenance.rationale: Recent population estimates around 123–124 million, with slight decline; foreign residents included.

inputs.name: annual_movers_per_1000
inputs.description: Annual number of people who move between municipalities per 1,000 population.

provenance.rationale: Internal migration rate in Japan has been around 3–5% of population per year in recent years.

inputs.name: august_seasonal_factor
inputs.description: Ratio of August internal migration volume to the average monthly volume.

provenance.rationale: August typically sees higher moves due to summer relocations and job changes.

inputs.name: months_per_year
inputs.description: Number of months in a year.

provenance.rationale: Definitional constant.

inputs.name: movers_per_1000_per_month
inputs.description: Monthly number of people who move between municipalities per 1,000 population.

provenance.rationale: Annual rate divided by 12, consistent with 40 per 1000 per year.

inputs.name: movers_per_1000_august
inputs.description: August-specific number of people who move between municipalities per 1,000 population.

provenance.rationale: August rate adjusted upward from monthly average due to seasonal peak.

inputs.name: annual_moves_per_mover
inputs.description: Average number of municipality-to-municipality moves per person who moves at least once in a year.

provenance.rationale: Most movers move once; a small fraction move multiple times.

inputs.name: share_movers_in_august
inputs.description: Share of annual internal migration moves that occur in August.

provenance.rationale: August is one of the busier months; roughly 1/12 to 1/8 of annual moves.

inputs.name: annual_movers
inputs.description: Total number of people who moved between municipalities within Japan in a year.

provenance.rationale: Roughly 4–5% of population moves annually, consistent with recent migration reports.

inputs.name: august_share_of_annual
inputs.description: Fraction of annual internal migration moves that occur in August.

provenance.rationale: August is a peak month; share slightly above 1/12.

inputs.name: japan_households
inputs.description: Number of households in Japan.

provenance.rationale: Recent household estimates around 54–56 million.

inputs.name: annual_household_move_rate
inputs.description: Annual rate of household moves between municipalities.

provenance.rationale: About 5% of households move annually, consistent with migration statistics.

inputs.name: august_household_share
inputs.description: Share of annual household moves occurring in August.

provenance.rationale: August is a peak moving month; share slightly above 1/12.

inputs.name: people_per_household_move
inputs.description: Average number of people per household move.

provenance.rationale: Average household size in Japan is about 2.2, but movers tend to be smaller households; 1.8 is a reasonable average.

paths.description: Estimate annual internal migration from population and annual mover rate, then allocate to August using seasonal share.
Estimate August moves from population and August-specific mover rate per 1000.
Estimate August moves from household moves: households × annual move rate × August share × people per move.

path p2: formula: numeric constant 1000 not allowed (only 1 and exponents); make it a named input
path p3: dimension mismatch: formula gives s**-1, target is dimensionless
